description: This 2000 Honda S2000 Base is a two-seat roadster built around a focused driving package that keeps the equipment list straightforward. Honda paired the compact body with a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive arrangement and a close-coupled cabin that leaves little space between the occupants and the mechanical components. The car uses a manually operated convertible top, and the open body style is central to its design. The exterior shape is clean and compact, with short overhangs, a long hood, and a low stance that reflects the proportions used on this model from the factory. Panels, glass, and trim are arranged with a clear emphasis on simplicity rather than ornamentation, and the overall presentation matches the car's purpose as a small, lightweight performance model.This example includes leather seats, which add a more finished surface to the interior than the standard cloth upholstery found on many cars in this class. The cabin is arranged for two occupants, and the seating position is low relative to the body sides and windshield frame. Controls are placed within easy reach of the driver, with a straightforward dash design and clearly grouped switches. Materials and finishes are selected to suit a roadster rather than a larger touring car, and the interior keeps unnecessary details to a minimum. Storage space is limited, as expected, and the passenger compartment remains compact, with the kind of dimensions that align with the car's size and purpose.This example also includes keyless entry, which provides remote access to the vehicle without requiring the key to be inserted at the door. The feature is one of the few convenience items noted on this car, and it fits the relatively simple equipment list. The body structure and doors are sized for the small footprint of the car, and the opening dimensions reflect the limited cabin width. The windshield is steeply raked, the side glass is short, and the rear deck is low, leaving the vehicle with proportions that are easy to identify. Exterior hardware remains restrained, with the design avoiding excess trim and keeping attention on the basic elements required for daily use.This S2000 uses Honda's naturally aspirated 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine, a unit known for its high-revving character and compact packaging. Power is delivered through a six-speed manual transmission, which is the only gearbox offered on this model. The drivetrain sends output to the rear wheels, and the chassis is tuned for a responsive road feel rather than relaxed cruising. Four-wheel independent suspension, ventilated front disc brakes, and rear disc brakes are part of the standard mechanical package. The steering is direct and unassisted by the wide body or soft isolation found in larger cars, and the wheelbase, track width, and overall mass work together to support the car's sharp on-road behavior. Inside, the instrumentation remains clear and centered on driver information, with a tachometer placed prominently and the rest of the gauges arranged for quick reference.

description: AVAILABLE AT KEATING CHEVROLET!!! 2016 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 3LT  Turn heads in this 2016 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 3LT, finished in striking Arctic White with a premium Kalahari interior. This rear-wheel-drive Corvette combines legendary V8 performance with the enhanced handling and braking capability of the Z51 Performance Package, along with the luxurious features of the 3LT trim.  Performance & Mechanical  At the heart of this Corvette is the 6.2L V8 DI engine, producing 455 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque. The performance exhaust increases output to 460 horsepower while delivering an aggressive exhaust note through polished 4-inch stainless-steel tips.  The Z51 package adds a performance-tuned suspension, performance 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, a rear differential cooler, dry-sump oil system, speed-sensitive variable-ratio steering, and black-painted brake calipers. The Corvette also features a 2.73 performance rear axle ratio and lightweight aluminum construction.  Exterior  The Arctic White exterior is complemented by black Z51-style aluminum wheels, measuring 19 x 8.5 inches up front and 20 x 10 inches in the rear, along with performance-focused styling.  Additional exterior highlights include the body-color removable roof panel, Carbon Flash-painted rear spoiler and outside mirrors, Carbon Flash badge package, HID Xenon headlamps with LED park and turn signals, heated power-adjustable mirrors with driver-side auto-dimming, and Solar-Ray light-tinted glass.  Premium Kalahari Interior  Inside, the Corvette features a premium Kalahari 3LT interior with leather appointments throughout the cabin. The Custom Leather-Wrapped Interior Package adds leather-wrapped upper instrument panel, upper door trim panels, and console storage cover, while the Sueded Microfiber-Wrapped Upper Interior Trim Package adds suede microfiber to the headliner, visors, A-pillars, and upper interior trim.  The driver and passenger enjoy 8-way power seats with power lumbar and power bolster adjustment, plus heated and ventilated seating. A flat-bottom, leather-wrapped 3-spoke steering wheel includes audio, voice recognition, and Driver Information Center controls.  Technology & Convenience  This Corvette is loaded with technology, including a color Head-Up Display with street and track modes, G-meter, vehicle speed, and engine RPM. The Performance Data and Video Recorder lets you capture and review your driving performance.  Additional features include a Bose Advanced 10-speaker audio system with bass box, dual-zone automatic climate control, auto-dimming frameless rearview mirror, Universal Home Remote, power windows with express up/down, remote vehicle start, electric rear-window defogger, and multiple convenient storage compartments.  Safety  Safety features include frontal and side-impact airbags with Passenger Sensing System, a Rear Vision Camera, and front Curb View cameras for added visibility when maneuvering. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back.  Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you.  If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car.
